questions.question: What is the relationship between the discovery of penicillin and the development of antibiotics?

answer_path.description: First antibiotic discovered by Alexander Fleming
Class of drugs that inhibit bacterial growth

ground_truth_evidence: Penicillin was the first antibiotic used in medicine
The discovery led to the development of many other antibiotics
questions.expected_answer: Alexander Fleming's discovery of penicillin in 1928 led to the development of antibiotics, as penicillin was the first antibiotic used in medicine and paved the way for many other antibiotics.
